name: Product Delivery
definition: Arrangements for delivery of invoiced products and/or services.

DeliveryPeriod.name: Delivery Period
DeliveryPeriod.definition: Actual delivery period of the products and/or services.

Routing.name: Routing
Routing.definition: Information related to the conveyance of goods.

TradeSettlement.name: Trade Settlement
TradeSettlement.definition: Specifies the settlement operation which originates the delivery of a product.

Obligation.name: Obligation
Obligation.definition: Specifies the obligation which is offset by the delivery of a product.

TradeCertificate.name: Trade Certificate
TradeCertificate.definition: Formal document used to record a fact and used as proof of the fact, in the context of a commercial trade transaction.

InsuranceCertificate.name: Insurance Certificate
InsuranceCertificate.definition: Formal document used to record a fact and used as proof of the fact that goods have been insured under an insurance policy.

Product.name: Product
Product.definition: Specifies the type of goods and services linked to the quantity.
